spectators.label: Cigar tycoon
spectators.look: rotund middle-aged tycoon with slicked-back gray hair, a thick walrus mustache and a monocle; white three-piece suit with gold buttons straining over his belly, red bow tie, gold pocket-watch chain, a fat smoking cigar
spectators.idle: puffing the cigar, thumbs hooked in his vest pockets
spectators.cheer: arms spread to the sides with the cigar in one hand, guffawing
spectators.shocked: cigar dropping, monocle popping out of his eye

spectators.label: Lady with peacock fan
spectators.look: elegant woman with dark violet hair in a tall updo pinned with jeweled hairpins and a beauty mark; long emerald-green silk high-collar gown with gold embroidery, white elbow gloves, a folding fan painted with a blue-green peacock-feather pattern
spectators.idle: fanning herself delicately, eyes half closed
spectators.cheer: fan snapped open and raised high, delighted
spectators.shocked: fan pressed over her mouth, eyes wide

spectators.label: Butler with tea tray
spectators.look: thin, ramrod-straight elderly butler with neat white hair and a curled white mustache; black tailcoat, gray vest, crisp white shirt with a black bow tie, white gloves, a silver tray balanced on one hand with a porcelain teacup
spectators.idle: tray balanced perfectly on one hand, expression unreadable
spectators.cheer: tray held out to the side, other hand lifted in a polite small wave
spectators.shocked: teacup jumping off the tray, eyebrows shooting up

spectators.label: Spoiled rich boy
spectators.look: small haughty boy with a shiny blond bowl cut and his nose in the air; navy sailor suit with short pants, white knee socks, polished black shoes, a giant rainbow swirl lollipop
spectators.idle: licking the lollipop with his chin up

spectators.label: Heiress with drill curls
spectators.look: proud young heiress with long golden hair in big ringlet drill curls and a huge pink bow; frilly pink-and-white lace dress with puffed sleeves, white gloves, a white lace parasol
spectators.idle: parasol on her shoulder, back of her hand at her mouth in a haughty laugh
spectators.cheer: twirling the parasol high, laughing loudly
spectators.shocked: parasol blown inside out, drill curls bouncing

spectators.label: Oil baron
spectators.look: big tanned rancher-tycoon with a white ten-gallon hat and a gray handlebar mustache; cream western suit, turquoise bolo tie, chunky gold rings, pointed brown cowboy boots, a thick stack of plain green paper bills
spectators.idle: fanning himself with the stack of green bills
spectators.cheer: tossing bills out to the sides, whooping
spectators.shocked: bills scattering, hat jumping off his head

spectators.label: Matriarch with opera glasses
spectators.look: tiny elderly matriarch with a towering silver beehive hairdo and cat-eye glasses on a chain; purple fur stole over a black velvet dress, several strands of pearls, gold opera glasses on a handle
spectators.idle: peering at the ring through her opera glasses
spectators.cheer: shaking the opera glasses in the air, cackling
spectators.shocked: clutching her pearls, opera glasses dropped

spectators.label: Young tech CEO
spectators.look: sharp young executive with a sleek silver-gray undercut and rimless glasses; slim black suit with a purple tie, silver wristwatch, a thin glowing tablet in one hand
spectators.cheer: tablet tucked under his arm, fist pump, glasses glinting

spectators.label: Bodyguard in black
spectators.look: massive bodyguard with a flat-top haircut, black sunglasses and a coiled earpiece wire; black suit tight across enormous shoulders, white shirt, thin black tie, hands clasped in front
spectators.cheer: one stiff fist raised out to the side, still stone-faced
spectators.shocked: sunglasses sliding down his nose, eyebrows shooting up

spectators.label: Top-hat aristocrat
spectators.look: slender older aristocrat with a tall black top hat and a neat pointed goatee; burgundy velvet tailcoat, white cravat, gray striped trousers, a black cane with a silver head
spectators.idle: both hands resting on the cane, polite smile
spectators.cheer: tipping the top hat high, cane lifted
spectators.shocked: top hat popping off, cane slipping from his grip

spectators.label: Socialite with lapdog
spectators.look: glamorous woman with a sleek black bob, big sparkling drop earrings and red lips; white fur coat over a sapphire-blue evening dress, a small fluffy white lapdog with a pink bow held in her arms
spectators.idle: stroking the lapdog in her arms
spectators.cheer: lifting the lapdog up, both looking thrilled
spectators.shocked: lapdog's fur puffed out, she gasps

spectators.label: Merchant with gold abacus
spectators.look: plump merchant with a long thin drooping mustache and a small round black cap; red silk robe with gold coin-pattern embroidery and a black sash, cloth shoes, a shiny gold abacus
spectators.idle: clicking the beads of the gold abacus

spectators.label: Little princess with teddy
spectators.look: little rich girl with lavender twin ringlets and a small silver tiara; puffy royal-blue velvet dress with a white lace collar, white tights, shiny red shoes, hugging a big brown teddy bear
spectators.idle: hugging the teddy bear, watching wide-eyed
spectators.shocked: hiding her face in the teddy bear

spectators.label: Gold-tooth gambler
spectators.look: slick gambler with slicked-back red hair, a pencil mustache and a flashing gold tooth; white fedora with a black band, pink pinstripe suit, black shirt with a white tie, a big gold ring, a fanned deck of playing cards
spectators.idle: shuffling the cards between his hands
spectators.cheer: spraying cards into the air, flashing the gold tooth
spectators.shocked: cards raining down, fedora tipped over his eyes
